Right, you asked me for one place and I am going to give you three, which is what always happens when you ask me anything. There is a bakery on the corner which opens at six, and the woman whose name is on the sign still makes the coffee herself. Go before eight, because after that it is packed and the regulars who stand at the counter are not moving for anybody. Then there is the restaurant two streets down where nobody takes a reservation. That one is my go-to when I cannot decide, and the owner cooks one dish a day, so do not ask for a menu. And the bar on the corner is a hidden gem that everybody in my building swears by. Please do not put any of this on the internet.

Ana, quick one before the call. The venue we booked for November is the old factory in Barra Funda, which is the one you visited in March. The person who signs everything off is called Renata, and she is the only one who can approve a change to the layout, so anything that touches the floor plan goes through her. The team we are working with is the same crew that did the Adidas activation, which is good news, because they already know the building. And the insight from the last event, which is the part the client actually cares about, was that people stay much longer in a space that has a story. So keep the factory walls. Do not paint anything.
